adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a large sustained jump in N (~25 mm) at index ~555, persisting through ~601, then a sharp return to pre-jump levels by index ~602. P1 (547–559) starts before the jump and ends during it; interior points (e.g., 555–559) are missing or inconsistent with a clean platform. P2 is a single-point spike (555) coinciding with onset but not a platform. P3 (555–601) aligns with the sustained offset and interior observations (e.g., indices 598–601 show stable high-N values), and the return occurs just after 601 (index 602 onward shows N ~-2.7, matching pre-jump). P4 (598–601) is fully contained within P3 and redundant; P5 (601) is the return point, not a platform. Only P3 represents a genuine temporary platform: sustained shift + opposing return across same axis (N), with interior stability and physical motion preserved elsewhere.
